timestamped_unit_ledger.result: Fresh independent generation/certification of 480 D2C graphs found 62 live-strip maximum-degree root states, 404 co-selected F-edge candidate occurrences and 13 crossed-supplement collision images. Unrestricted live-strip injectivity is refuted; all 13 collisions have multiplicity two, and exact certificate-choice DP found 0/13 allowing both collided labels positive demand.
Proved supplement-pair congestion bound M_pq<=codeg_{G[B]}(p,q), hence C<=sum_u binom(d_B(u),2)<=sum_u binom(b-a-1+q_u,2). Degree-only plateau relaxation remains too weak by factor about 84.03.

Proved graph-level necessary condition for positive demand: if h_i is B-H-degree and s_i counts unique-common-neighbour selectable incidences, then d_i>0 requires 2s_i>h_i. Every one of the 13 fresh live-strip collisions has at least one endpoint with 2s_i-h_i<=-2.
